name: San Ramón 15 iron-oxide mining
description: At San Ramón 15 on the northern Chilean coast, excavation found iron-oxide workings and stone hammerstones associated with Early Holocene deposits.

impact.note: One coastal community's early pigment mine shows organised extraction, a modest gain with no known later practice descending from it.

date.label: 8717–8472 cal BCE, dated charcoal in excavation unit 1
date.basis: Date of the stated witness or contextual sample, not a claim of global origin.

events.statement: At San Ramón 15 on the northern Chilean coast, excavation found iron-oxide workings and stone hammerstones associated with Early Holocene deposits.

evidence.supports: The authors describe iron-oxide workings and 491 hammerstones recovered from early Holocene levels. Unit 1 layer 7 charcoal sample UGAMS 5442 has a listed calibrated range of 8717–8472 BCE; it dates associated context rather than each tool or mine origin.

events.caveats: The displayed dates are a calibrated charcoal sample from unit 1 layer 7, not a direct date of the entire mine or of every hammerstone. Other material indicates earlier and later use; similarities with other mines do not establish transmission or a single origin.
